angle: What two satellites infer from a changing gap

items.claim: The twin satellites follow one another about 220 kilometers apart.
items.synthesisExcerpt: Twin satellites follow each other about 137 miles or 220 kilometers apart.
items.sourceEvidence: Twin satellites follow each other about 137 miles or 220 kilometers apart.
items.usefulness: Establishes the changing gap that anchors the explanation.

items.claim: A larger mass concentration first strengthens gravity’s pull on the leading satellite.
items.synthesisExcerpt: As the pair approaches a larger mass concentration, stronger gravity acts on the leading satellite first, initially pulling it farther from the trailing one.
items.sourceEvidence: As the pair approaches a larger mass concentration, stronger gravity acts on the leading satellite first, initially pulling it farther from the trailing one.
items.usefulness: Explains why the satellites’ spacing changes.
items.qualification: The gravitational effect comes before the spacing change.

items.claim: Changing inter-satellite distance is measured to infer shifts in mass.
items.synthesisExcerpt: The changing inter-satellite distance is a raw measurement used to infer shifts in mass.
items.sourceEvidence: The changing inter-satellite distance is a raw measurement used to infer shifts in mass.
items.usefulness: Clarifies what the measurement tells scientists.
items.qualification: The measurement is indirect, not a direct view of groundwater.

items.claim: The mission follows changes in several forms of water storage and water added to the oceans.
items.synthesisExcerpt: The mission follows changes involving groundwater, lakes and rivers, soil moisture, glaciers, ice sheets and changes in sea level attributable to water added to the oceans.
items.sourceEvidence: The mission follows changes involving groundwater, lakes and rivers, soil moisture, glaciers, ice sheets and changes in sea level attributable to water added to the oceans.
items.usefulness: Provides the endpoint: the water movements these measurements help investigate.
items.qualification: The sea-level claim is limited to water added to the oceans.
